jobs.description:
We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Technical Customer Success Manager (Spanish) (m/f/d) Your Role

As Technical Customer Success Manager for the Spanish market, you are the primary point of contact for your customer cohort (of SMBs) once they've signed. You own their success, satisfaction, and retention end to end.

You actively build relationships, identify value drivers, and ensure every customer gets the most out of fonio. You'll spend most of your time in calls and meetings with customers and implementing or improving their setups.

 

What to expect

 * Own a portfolio of Spanish SMB customers across their full lifecycle

 * Build relationships, surface value, and find new use cases for AI agents to keep customers engaged

 * Support customers in setting up their AI assistant; implement workflows for medium complex cases and coordinate with developers for advanced setups

 * Run check-ins and proactive calls based on usage signals (low engagement, expansion opportunities, setup friction)

 * Work with a ready-made pipeline and clear playbooks, with room to test your own initiatives

 * Maximize the value generated from each customer in your portfolio

 * Spot churn risks early and act on them

 * Manage your activity autonomously in HubSpot

 

Who We're Looking For

 * 2-5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, Forward Deployment Engineer or a technical client-facing SaaS/B2B role

 * Ideally a strong technical understanding - comfortable understanding API documentation and error logs to troubleshoot customer setup issues independently

 * Experience with tools like n8n, make.com, codex or similar

 * An affinity for tech / AI products is a real plus

 * Native or C2 Spanish, strong English

 * Structured, autonomous, results-driven

 * You build trust easily with customers, by phone or video

 * You take initiative, test, iterate, and don't wait to be told what to do

 * Comfortable with CRM (ideally HubSpot) and data-driven workflows

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna for 1-2 months initially

 

What We Offer

 * €60,000-80,000 OTE

 * Equity: you help build it, you should own a piece of it

 * Equipment of your choice

 * A product that sells itself and that customers love (4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google, and OMR)

 * Regular team offsites

 * Office in Vienna or Barcelona, onsite, in an ambitious team that wants to do the most exciting work of their careers

 

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 30 min getting to know the country's Go-to-Market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Marketing Engineer Your Role

As our Marketing Engineer, you sit at the intersection of data science and paid media. You'll consolidate scattered customer signals into a single source of truth, build ML models that score leads by their real value, and feed those insights back into our ad platforms - making our marketing smarter than the platforms' out-of-the-box optimization. It's a hands-on, build-from-scratch role with full ownership over both the models and the impact they create.

What to expect

 * Build our predictive CLTV modelling from the ground up: consolidate customer signals into a database, develop ML models on user behavior to score leads

 * Feed those scores back into the ad platforms (Meta, Google, and more) to sharpen targeting and bidding

 * Own tracking and conversion infrastructure: Tag Manager, Search Console, offline uploads, server-side setups

 * Turn raw behavioral data into measurable performance impact

 * Work closely with the Performance Marketing team and Go-to-Market managers

Who We're Looking For

 * You're comfortable building data pipelines and ML models - Python, SQL, and modern ML tooling are second nature

 * You understand paid media well enough to know what signals matter and how platforms consume them

 * Experience with attribution, conversion APIs, or offline conversion uploads is a strong plus

 * Hardworking, analytical, structured, and a natural fit for a direct, ambitious culture

 * Strong English skills, as English is our company language

 * German skills are a big plus

What We Offer

 * Competitive Salary: €65.000-€130.000

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it.

 * Food & drinks - at our Vienna office, lunch and dinner are on us (plus all the drinks your heart desires, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

 * Relocation bonus (if you still need to move to Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.

 * Regular team offsites.

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 15 min Culture fit with the founders
